title: 第0099章大比惊变 仙茅破障 一拳崩山震天第0098章 仙茅破障一拳撼苍狼
content_zh:
【前文回顾】
林药尘在家族后山绝地，以仙鹤草吊住性命，借白鲜皮祛除“腐骨散”大半毒素，终于将破损的经脉勉强接续。他于深夜潜回废柴小院，却正好撞见林家少主林啸天带着心腹前来“验尸”，意图彻底断绝后患。林药尘不再隐忍，于黑暗中睁眼，杀机凛然……
------
夜色如墨，浓稠得化不开。
青石板上凝结着冰冷的露水，映着惨淡的月光，像是一滩滩未干的泪痕。林家后山脚下的废柴小院，平日里连护院都懒得来巡视，此刻却被几道高大的身影堵得严严实实。
林啸天负手而立，一身锦袍衬得他越发挺拔，周身隐隐有灵气流转，已是聚气境三重的修为。他低头看着躺在破木板床上的那个“死人”，嘴角挂着毫不掩饰的讥讽。
“林药尘，你这个废物，倒也命硬。中了本少主的‘腐骨散’，竟还能拖到现在。”林啸天身旁，狗腿子王麻子搓着手，一脸谄媚：“少主爷神功盖世，那腐骨散可是黑市里买来的好东西，这废物就算有九条命，也得交代在这儿。”
床上，林药尘双目紧闭，脸色蜡黄，气息微弱得几乎察觉不到。然而，只有他自己知道，体内正经历着怎样翻天覆地的变化。
丹田内，那枚由“万古药尊系统”凝聚的药种，正散发着温热的暖流。仙鹤草的药力如同细密的丝线，在破碎的经脉中断处穿梭，强行缝合；而白鲜皮的药力则化作一股股清泉，冲刷着骨髓深处残留的黑绿色毒素。
【叮！检测到宿主生命体征恢复至安全阈值，绝脉修复进度：30%……】
【白鲜皮解毒进度：85%……剩余毒素已逼入指尖末梢……】
就在王麻子伸出手，想要去探林药尘的鼻息时，一直毫无动静的林药尘，忽然动了。
他没有睁眼，只是左手如闪电般探出，精准地扣住了王麻子的手腕。那力道之大，让王麻子感觉像是被铁钳夹住，骨骼发出不堪重负的“咯吱”声。
“啊——！”王麻子惨叫一声，吓得脸色惨白，“少、少主！这废物装死！”
林啸天眉头一皱，眼中闪过一丝阴鸷，但很快又舒展开来，冷笑道：“装死？垂死挣扎罢了。王麻子，退下，既然他还没死透，本少主就送他一程！”
话音未落，林啸天右手并指如剑，指尖凝聚起一团土黄色的灵气，正是林家嫡传武学《厚土掌》！这一掌若是拍实了，林药尘哪怕修复了30%的经脉，也要被彻底震碎内脏。
然而，就在林啸天的手掌距离林药尘胸口仅有三寸之时。
林药尘的眼睛，猛地睁开了。
那是一双怎样的眼睛？
没有恐惧，没有绝望，反而深邃如寒潭，在那潭底，压抑着即将喷发的火山。

“林啸天……”林药尘的声音嘶哑低沉，却带着一种令人心悸的穿透力，“想杀我，你还不够格。”
“放肆！”林啸天大怒，没想到一个将死的废物还敢嘴硬，手中力道骤增，“给我死！”
就在掌风即将及体的瞬间，林药尘体内，那一直处于沉寂状态的第二株奇药——仙茅，终于觉醒了它的霸道之力！
仙茅，又名地棕、独茅，性温味辛，专破沉疴，开通心窍，助阳破障！
在系统的催化下，仙茅的药力如同烈火烹油，瞬间在林药尘的四肢百骸炸开。原本只恢复了三成的经脉，在这一刻被狂暴的药力强行撑开，虽然传来撕裂般的剧痛，但换来的是一股从未有过的磅礴力量！
“给我——滚！”
林药尘喉咙深处发出一声低吼，右拳紧握，没有动用任何花哨的武技，纯粹是依靠仙茅激发的肉身力量，迎着林啸天的手掌轰了上去！
“砰！”
气劲交鸣。
林啸天脸上的狞笑瞬间凝固，转而化为极致的惊恐。他感觉到一股刚猛无俦的力量顺着接触点疯狂涌入，自己那引以为傲的《厚土掌》在这股力量面前，竟如纸糊一般脆弱！
“咔嚓！”
臂骨断裂的声音清晰可闻。
林啸天整个人倒飞而出，狠狠撞在院墙上，一口鲜血狂喷而出，染红了胸前的锦袍。
“少主！”
王麻子和另外两名护院大惊失色，连忙上前搀扶。
此时再看林药尘，他已从床上坐起，周身虽然气息还有些虚浮，但那挺直的脊梁，却仿佛一杆标枪，刺破了这漫漫长夜。他缓缓抬起右手，指尖微微颤抖，那是力量透支的征兆，但更多的是兴奋。
“这……这怎么可能！”林啸天捂着断臂，满脸不可置信，“你不是绝脉吗？中了腐骨散你怎么还能动用灵气？”
content_en:
[Review of previous article]
Lin Yaochen was in a desperate situation at the back of his family, using agrimony to hang on to his life. He used white fresh skin to remove most of the toxins in the "Rotten Bone Powder", and finally managed to reconnect the damaged meridians. He sneaked back to the waste wood courtyard late at night, but happened to encounter Lin Xiaotian, the young master of the Lin family, who came with his confidants to conduct an "autopsy", intending to completely eliminate future troubles. Lin Yaochen no longer held back and opened his eyes in the darkness with murderous intent...
------
The night was like ink, too thick to dissolve.
Cold dew condensed on the bluestone, reflecting the pale moonlight, like pools of undried tears. The small useless courtyard at the foot of the hill behind Lin's house, where even the nursing staff usually didn't bother to inspect it, was now blocked by several tall figures.
Lin Xiaotian stood with his hands behind his back. His brocade robe made him taller and taller. There was faint spiritual energy flowing around his body. He was already at the third level of Qi Gathering Realm. He looked down at the "dead man" lying on the broken wooden bed with undisguised sarcasm on his lips.
"Lin Yaochen, you are such a good-for-nothing. You were hit by my young master's 'Rotten Bone Powder', but you are still able to survive until now." Beside Lin Xiaotian, the loser Wang Mazi rubbed his hands with a flattering look on his face: "Young Master has incredible skills, and that rotten bone powder is a good thing bought on the black market. Even if this loser has nine lives, he has to account for it here."
On the bed, Lin Yaochen's eyes were closed tightly, his face was sallow, and his breath was so weak that he could hardly detect it. However, only he himself knew what earth-shaking changes his body was going through.
In the Dantian, the medicinal seed condensed by the "Eternal Medicine Master System" is emitting a warm current. The medicinal power of agrimony is like fine silk threads, weaving through the interruptions of broken meridians and forcibly suturing them; while the medicinal power of white fresh skin is turned into streams of clear springs, washing away the black and green toxins remaining deep in the bone marrow.
【bite! It is detected that the host's vital signs have returned to the safe threshold, and the repair progress of the dead veins: 30%...]
[Baixianpi detoxification progress: 85%...the remaining toxins have been forced into the fingertips...]
Just when Wang Mazi stretched out his hand to feel Lin Yaochen's breath, Lin Yaochen, who had been motionless, suddenly moved.
He didn't open his eyes, but stretched out his left hand like lightning and grasped Wang Mazi's wrist accurately. The force was so strong that Wang Mazi felt as if he was being clamped by iron pincers, and his bones made an overwhelmed "creaking" sound.
"Ah——!" Wang Mazi screamed, his face turned pale with fright, "Young, Young Master! This good-for-nothing is pretending to be dead!"
Lin Xiaotian frowned, a hint of evil flashed in his eyes, but he soon relaxed and sneered: "Pretending to be dead? It's just a dying struggle. Wang Mazi, step back, since he is not dead yet, I will give him a ride!"
Before he finished speaking, Lin Xiaotian pointed his right hand together like a sword, and a ball of earth-yellow aura condensed on his fingertips. It was the martial arts "Thick Earth Palm" passed down by the Lin family! If this palm was applied properly, even if Lin Yaochen could repair 30% of his meridians, his internal organs would still be completely shattered.
However, just when Lin Xiaotian's palm was only three inches away from Lin Yaochen's chest.
Lin Yaochen's eyes suddenly opened.
What kind of eyes are those?
There is no fear, no despair, but as deep as a cold pool, at the bottom of which suppresses the volcano that is about to erupt.
"Lin Xiaotian..." Lin Yaochen's voice was hoarse and low, but it carried a heart-stopping power, "If you want to kill me, you are not qualified."
"Presumptuous!" Lin Xiaotian was furious. He didn't expect that a dying waste would dare to speak harshly. The strength in his hands suddenly increased, "Die!"
At the moment when the wind from his palm was about to reach his body, the second strange medicine in Lin Yaochen's body, Curculigo, which had been in a silent state, finally awakened its domineering power!
Curculigo, also known as Ground Palm and Solitary Grass, is warm in nature and pungent in taste. It is specially designed to treat chronic diseases, open up the heart orifices, and help Yang break through obstacles!
Under the catalysis of the system, Curculigo's medicinal power was like fire cooking oil, instantly exploding on Lin Yaochen's limbs and bones. Originally only 30% of the meridians were restored, but at this moment they were violentlyThe medicine forcefully opened it, and although there was a tearing pain, it was replaced by a majestic force that had never been seen before!
"Get out of here!"
Lin Yaochen let out a low roar from deep in his throat, clenched his right fist tightly, and without using any fancy martial arts, he purely relied on the physical power inspired by curculigo to hit Lin Xiaotian's palm!
"Bang!"
The energy and energy are mixed together.
The ferocious smile on Lin Xiaotian's face instantly froze and turned into extreme panic. He felt a fierce and ruthless force rushing in along the contact point. His proud "Thick Earth Palm" was as fragile as paper in front of this force!
"Crack!"
The sound of broken arm bones was clearly audible.
Lin Xiaotian flew backwards and hit the courtyard wall hard. A mouthful of blood spurted out, staining the brocade robe on his chest red.
"Young Master!"
Wang Mazi and the other two nursing staff were shocked and quickly stepped forward to help him.
Looking at Lin Yaochen at this time, he had already sat up from the bed. Although his breath was still a little weak, his straight spine was like a javelin piercing the long night. He slowly raised his right hand, his fingertips trembling slightly, which was a sign of overstretched strength, but more of a sign of excitement.
"This... how is this possible!" Lin Xiaotian covered his broken arm with disbelief on his face, "Aren't you Juepui? How can you still use spiritual energy after being hit by rotten bones?"
